verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 17 : vaahiguroo pare to(n) pare hai

en.bdb: Waheguru, the wondrous Lord is beond all limits

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: agamahu agam aga(n)m hai agam agam at agam sunaae|

en.bdb: The Lord is beyond accessibility and all call Him extremely inaccessible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: alakhahu alakh alakh hai alakh alakh lakh alakh dhiaae|

en.bdb: He was imperceptible; He is imperceptible and will remain inaccessible i.e. He is beyond all meditations.
Beyond all limits whatsoever is illimitable; the Lord is beyond imagination.
He is imperceptible of the imperceptibles and is beyond the reach of sense organs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਅਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham saadhasa(n)gat aagaadh alaae|

en.bdb: The transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm who is eulogised in the holy congregation in many ways.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaae|

en.bdb: The joy of His love is the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs. The Lord is loving to devotees but is never deluded even by the biggest cheats
By his grace alone, one can go across the World Ocean enthusiastically.
